episodes.title: TV Special
episodes.synopsis:
In Bastille, France, the treasure of the Bourbon Dynasty was stacked in a truck and stolen. Thinking it was undoubtedly Lupin's doing, Zenigata and the French police pursue the truck. But, the criminal was actually an unheard-of woman. Then, the true Lupin appears. Lupin successfully steals the truckload of treasure from the woman but is then mysteriously kidnapped.
Malchovich is the man who kidnapped Lupin. Fujiko is also caught and kept hostage while trying to steal the worldwide famous jewel "Bull's Eye". In order to rescue Fujiko, Lupin, along with reluctant Jigen and Goemon, tries to steal Bull's Eye from the Grand Bateau, the French museum renowned for having the greatest security in the world. Everything starts from here!
Female thief Becky, scoundrel Malchovich, and Lupin... Ambition, human relations... Each secret becomes gradually clear during the scramble for the Bull's Eye. The series' highest spectacle romance unfolds, and France is the stage.

info.title: Cardcaptor Sakura The Movie (ITA)
info.synopsis: La vita scorre regolare per Sakura e compagni che continuano, come sempre, a condurre una vita scolastica normale e a catturare le carte di Clow. Dopo aver catturato la carta della Freccia il libro di Clow reagisce e Sakura comincia a fare strani sogni poi, non tanto casualmente, si ritrova a vincere ad una lotteria un viaggio per quattro persone ad Hong Kong. In un posto tanto suggestivo però si possono nascondere anche pericoli, specie se vi abita uno spirito inquieto.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: Sakura Kinomoto, a Card Captor, wins a game of chance and is awarded a trip to Hong Kong, along with her best friend Tomoyo and her rival, Syaoran Li. It turns out that the ancient rival of Clow Reed, the creator of the mysterious and powerful Clow Cards, summoned them, and she's out for revenge. A battle ensues, and secrets are revealed about Clow Reed's shady past and Sakura's connection to him.

info.title: Monster Hunter Stories: Ride On (ITA)
info.synopsis: Stringi l'amicizia con il tuo mostro, che inizi l'avventura del rider! Questo è un mondo dove esistono sia mostri che umani. Coloro che cacciano i mostri vengono chiamati Cacciatori ma in un piccolo angolo del mondo dei Cacciatori ci sono i Riders, persone che creano un rapporto coi mostri, che coesistono con loro. Utilizzando la loro Kizuna Ishi (in inglese Bonding Stones) possono risvegliare il potere nascosto dentro i mostri, vivendo così insieme ai loro Otomon, ovvero i mostri coi quali hanno formato una connessione. Ryuto è un giovane ragazzo che vive ad Hakum, un villaggio di Rider ed il suo più grande sogno è quello di diventare il miglior Rider al mondo. Avendo appena compiuto 12 anni comincia la sua avventura, lascia la sua città e cerca il suo Otomon, prima della cerimonia nella quale riceverà il suo Kizuna Ishi. Insieme a Shuval, suo docile amico d'infanzia, Lilia, anche lei una sua compagnia d'infanzia e anche molto curiosa, ed infine il suo compagno Naviloo entra nella foresta ed ha un incredibile contro con Rathalos. La storia inizia proprio quando il Rider ed il suo Otomon appofondiscono il loro legame.

episodes.title: The Power of Bonds
episodes.synopsis: Aspiring young Rider Lute and friends go in search of a Monstie Egg on the eve of the Kinship Rite. A search that takes them into dangerous territory.

episodes.title: A Monstie Is Born!
episodes.synopsis: It's Kinship Rite time! Lilia and Cheval are uncertain about their futures, while an unexpected attack on Hakum Village sends its Riders scrambling.

episodes.title: Absolute Power
episodes.synopsis: A Hunter is headed for secretive Hakum Village. He's sure to have his own way of dealing with all these monsters showing up where they don't belong...

episodes.title: The Kinship Rite
episodes.synopsis: Chief Omna sends the apprentice Riders off in search of the Waterfall of Trials. A visitor to Hakum Village gives Lilia inspiration for her future.

episodes.title: Off to the Monstie Races
episodes.synopsis: Hakum Village revives the beloved Monstie Races for their four newest Riders, but Lute could still use a lot more practice piloting his powerful pal.

episodes.title: Quest for the Golden Egg
episodes.synopsis: Lute and friends dream about what they'd buy with the proceeds from a rare and valuable golden Gargwa egg, and Cheval decides to try hunting one down.

episodes.title: Like Mom Used to Make
episodes.synopsis: The mischievous twins Den-Den and Lin-Lin are stirring up trouble in Hakum Village--and run into trouble of their own in the forboding woods at night.

episodes.title: Navirou in Love
episodes.synopsis: Ms. Pink the traveling merchant stops by the village, and Navirou falls hard for her Felyne assistant Mocha. How far will he go in the name of love?

episodes.title: DSZ (Dan and Silva`s Zeal!)
episodes.synopsis: Dan has doubts about whether he should be leading the Riders in training, and remembers his old friend Silva, who was once a shoo-in to be the leader.

episodes.title: Portent of Disaster
episodes.synopsis: In the latest ill omen, the village's beneficial wind turns violent. Hyoro struggles to live up to the expectations of his demanding brother Genie.

episodes.title: Before the Storm
episodes.synopsis: Lilia leads her friends into the woods to investigate the evil changes taking place. There they learn about a legendary Rider and about Lute's folks.

episodes.title: Invasion of the Nargacuga
episodes.synopsis: A Blight-mad Nargacuga attacks the village, leaving a trail of blind destruction in its wake as Riders young and old do all they can to drive it away.

episodes.title: A Lioleia Is Born!
episodes.synopsis: There's no time to clean up after the Nargacuga when it could attack the village again at any moment. Cheval swears revenge and takes a new Monstie.

episodes.title: Face the Black Blight!
episodes.synopsis: The apprentice Riders go off on their own to face the Blighted Nargacuga, but it's going to be tough with Lute's Monstie still recovering back home...

episodes.title: The Journey Begins
episodes.synopsis: The time has come for the young Riders to venture forth beyond Hakum Village, accompanied by excitement, responsibility, and not a little trepidation.

episodes.title: Avinia`s Secret
episodes.synopsis: Having started their journey outside the village, Lute and Navirou get separated from the others, and find a girl who is hurt and in need of help.

episodes.title: Meet the Riddlemaster
episodes.synopsis: Lute, Navirou, and Avinia encounter an enigmatic, riddle-loving innkeeper who stands between them and the help Avinia needs for her beloved Monstie.

episodes.title: Welcome to Gildegaran
episodes.synopsis: Lute and friends are dazzled by the big city, but they soon get down to business: finding the Scriveners and a way to keep the Black Blight in check.

episodes.title: Nerscylla Blitz!
episodes.synopsis: It's questing time in the Hunter city of Gildegaran! A task that looks like a piece of cake winds up being more than Lute and Navirou bargained for.

episodes.title: The Legend of Pawpad Place
episodes.synopsis: Lute and Lilia stumble across a Felyne village while searching for a Kinship Ore. Navirou is confronted by a strange Felyne who insists they're pals.

episodes.title: Barroth, Landslide Wyvern
episodes.synopsis: Lilia brings the young Riders a request from the Scriveners that sends them through a vast desert in search of a solution to the Black Blight problem.

episodes.title: Desert Mayday
episodes.synopsis: The group meets with Hunter opposition in the Oasum refugee camp. A desert battle with a Blighted monster gets an unexpected (and unwelcome) assist.

episodes.title: The Horned Wyvern`s Lament
episodes.synopsis: Dan and the other senior Riders meet up with Lute's party in the desert, where Chief Nolma shares some info that changes the course of their quest.

episodes.title: Sky Wyvern, Land Wyvern
episodes.synopsis: The rift deepens between fellow Riders Lute and Cheval as their attitudes toward rogue monsters drift further apart. Lute reunites with an old friend.

episodes.title: Diabolical Diablos, Horned Wyvern
episodes.synopsis: After proving their mettle against the Blighted Diablos near the ruins of Reverto's hometown, the Riders reach an understanding about the road ahead.

episodes.title: The Mysterious White Dragon
episodes.synopsis: Lute wants the same Monstie as the legendary hero Redan. Debli's teacher seems to know where to find precisely the Monstie Egg he's looking for.

episodes.title: Dovan Volcano Memories
episodes.synopsis: Why does Navirou's head hurt at the very mention of the Dovan Volcano? Lute runs into a couple of troublemakers en route to the next Kinship Ore.

episodes.title: Onward, Numbers!
episodes.synopsis: Discarded like so much trash, Navirou happens to reunite with some old friends. If only he could remember them, or the grand plan they had to escape.

episodes.title: The Dragon in the Sea of Fire
episodes.synopsis: Lute and the Numbers face off against Dr. Manelger in his subterranean lab, where the mad scientist has an unpleasant mechanized surprise for them.

episodes.title: Parting Ways
episodes.synopsis: Bent on destroying Blighted monsters, Cheval confronts Lute over his beloved Monstie Ratha, who may not even have the strength to defend himself.

episodes.title: Be the Forest, Be the Beast
episodes.synopsis: Lute and Reverto track a monster into a mine (despite rumors that it's haunted). Whatever they find, what's more worrying is what finds THEM.

episodes.title: All-Out Airborne Assault!
episodes.synopsis: There's a Blighted monster on Naubaka Island, but no one who sails there comes back. Lute and friends brave the waves with the unique Bandit Captain.

episodes.title: The Wolf Raven Strikes Back
episodes.synopsis: Lute and Avinia must defend Koapni Village from the Blighted monster that's been terrorizing the island. Pansy has a big favor to ask Navirou.

episodes.title: Rainbow Beach Blockade!
episodes.synopsis: Chief Mallerie's pickle weight has been stolen! Never fear: Detective Navirou is on the case. Meanwhile, Lute searches for Naubaka's Kinship Ore.

episodes.title: The White Dragon`s Egg
episodes.synopsis: Lilia has a strong lead on the whereabouts of the legendary white dragon's egg, that sends Lute and friends into the ruins of the hero Redan's village.

episodes.title: The Great Manelger Chase
episodes.synopsis: Lute follows a tip from the Scriveners to outside Albrachs Village. When he tracks down Dr. Manelger, he gets a Hunter's help (headache).

episodes.title: Trouble Returns to Hakum
episodes.synopsis: A second Kinship Ore in Hakum Village? Lute returns to his hometown just in time to deal with the devastating fallout of the mad Manelger's meddling.

episodes.title: The Little Bouquet
episodes.synopsis: Cheval is back in Hakum Village! He may be too late to slay the Blighted beast, but he sticks around to confront and challenge his former friend Lute.

episodes.title: Tested at the Tower of Illusion
episodes.synopsis: Chief Omna brings Lute to the Tower of Illusion, where he undergoes a tense trial meant to dispel the doubt from his mind and lead him to the truth.

episodes.title: Brachydios the Destroyer
episodes.synopsis: Lute accompanies Reverto on a quest to slay Brachydios the Destroyer, an ultra-powerful tempered monster and the expert Hunter's longtime rival.

episodes.title: The Nargacuga Returns
episodes.synopsis: Before Ceval and his team head to the desert to find a Black Diablos running amok, Cheval takes an unexpected (and hopefully more obedient) new Monstie.

episodes.title: Numbers, Assemble!
episodes.synopsis: Lute and Navirou reunite with the Numbers as they search for another Kinship Ore on Mt. Rhyz, where some unexpected company puts their plans on hold.

episodes.title: Forest of Confusion
episodes.synopsis: Some familiar faces rejoin Lute on his journey into the Forest of Confusion, hot on the trail of the next Kinship Ore. But the Blight is spreading...

episodes.title: A Mystical Meeting with Kirin
episodes.synopsis: The team has a rare encounter with a mysterious Elder Dragon deep in the Forest of Confusion as they continue their search for the Kinship Ore.

episodes.title: The Deviljho of Mt. Celion
episodes.synopsis: The final Kinship Ore waits amid freezing mountain ruins. Lute and Manelger are in hot pursuit, but Cheval's new Mechinship Stone changes everything.

episodes.title: The Legendary White Dragon Is Born!
episodes.synopsis: Cheval flexes his newfound muscle with his white dragon Monstie, but even he's not safe from the Black Blight. Lute seeks a chance to patch things up.

episodes.title: This Is It: The Black Dread
episodes.synopsis: Lute and Cheval face the staggeringly powerful Black Dread, a monster capable of wiping entire villages off the map; Ratha has a fight of his own.

episodes.title: A Miracle in White
episodes.synopsis: Lute and Ratha's pitched battle with the formidable Black Dread rages on, but Lute's secret weapon (the power of Kinship) may finally turn the tide.

episodes.title: Attack of the Ebon Riders!
episodes.synopsis: It is fleeting that the world became peaceful, lutes who know that Ayuria was taken away. It seems that the name of the person who took him was Black Riders. It was a lute who tried to rescue Ayuria from them ...

episodes.title: A Strong and Dangerous Man Shrouded in Mystery
episodes.synopsis: Lute and the others find themselves unable to stand up to Gale of the Ebon Riders. Gale uses the Silver Rathalos, Dusk as his monstie and shows Lute and Ratha its overwhelming power. Gale mentioned that his monstie has undergone the Rite of Channeling. Will Lute and the others be able to escape this!?

episodes.title: The Biggest Narcissist Ever!? Mad Appears!
episodes.synopsis: Mille and Hyoro leave to look for the new Monstie egg. Meanwhile, Nariki and Beats try to reclaim the previous riders Kinship Stones. But then, Mad of the Ebon Riders appears!

episodes.title: The Forest Ninja, Shadow Arrives!
episodes.synopsis: Cheval leaves with Lute to look for Avinia by themselves. On their way they visit Wakadoka Village, which is protected by an elderly Rider, Talba. The villagers warmly welcome Cheval, but Shadow of the Ebon Riders was also lurking nearby...

episodes.title: Hang In There, Velocidrome!
episodes.synopsis: Nariki doesn't want to go to practice being treated badly by his Monstie Velocidrome, and Navigator Beats. Nariki gets into an argument with Beats. Meanwhile, the Ebon Rider, Wrath is getting closer and closer to Hakum…

episodes.title: For Avinia!
episodes.synopsis: To help save Avinia, Debli gathers info on the Ebon Riders in Gildegaran. He hears of the Rite of Channeling from Simone and heads to see the Channeler together with Fifi, to do the Rite to Great Poogie.

episodes.title: The Bolt Rathalos
episodes.synopsis: The Ebon Riders are scattered throughout the world to look for Lute and his Kinship Stone. Meanwhile, Lute is training with the Riddlemaster and heads to see a certain monster, to be granted a Kinship Gene.

episodes.title: A Lukewarm Kinship
episodes.synopsis: Cheval visits the Riddlemaster to undergo the Rite of Channeling. After being sent deep into the snowy mountains to a place with a strong monster, Cheval collapses with a fever. Cryo tries to save Cheval from this predicament, but then...?!

episodes.title: It`s Hard Being a Vice Captain
episodes.synopsis: Pappan is looking for info on the Ebon Riders. Hearing that Lilia has obtained a clue to the reason behind their Kinship Stone collecting, everyone heads to Omi Valley. However, it's such a dangerous place, it's known as a trial ground for Hunters...

episodes.title: Navirou`s Great Fart Plan!
episodes.synopsis: Everyone decides to go to Pawpad Place to look for info on the Ebon Riders. On their way, they come across Professor Manelger. They hope that he might have info on the Ebon Riders, but something seems off...

episodes.title: Darkness and Kinship
episodes.synopsis: Cheval's group heads toward Trese Desert. Cheval remembers Nargacuga, a monster he once had as a Monstie in this desert, but cut off his ties with. Meanwhile, Shadow, also heads to Trese Desert to harvest Kinship Stones.

episodes.title: Return of the Monstie Races!
episodes.synopsis: The Monstie Races will be held again in Hakum Village this year. Mille, Hyoro, Nariki rush to participate. As the race begins, everyone watches excitedly, but Wrath of the Ebon Riders has also snuck into Hakum Village to steal the Riders' Kinship Stones!

episodes.title: The Revival of Doctor Manelger?
episodes.synopsis: Ichibitsu appeared before the numbers. He says he wants Dr. Manelger to fall back to "research loss". Although it is non-elective numbers, I headed to the laboratory to obtain even Ayuria's information at all.

episodes.title: Lute vs. Gale Again!

info.synopsis: Un giorno, una giovane donna di nome Blanca viene salvata da Xuan, un cacciatore di serpenti di un villaggio vicino. Essendo senza memoria, insieme intraprendono un viaggio per scoprire la sua vera identità, sviluppando sentimenti più profondi l'uno per l'altra lungo il percorso. Ma mentre scoprono di più sul suo passato, svelano un'oscura trama di forze soprannaturali che lottano per il potere, con il destino del mondo in bilico. Concepito come un prequel a una delle storie più antiche e durature della storia cinese, White Snake presenta un racconto sontuoso di demoni imbroglioni, letali bestie mitiche, assassini, azione wuxia e la promessa di un amore eterno.

Un misterioso individuo è alla ricerca del segreto dell'immortalità e, per ottenerlo, è disposto a qualsiasi cosa, anche a sterminare tutto il genere umano. Giocare con le leggi della natura, però, può dimostrarsi estremamente pericoloso…

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis:
The Mystery of Mamo, also known as The Secret of Mamo, is a 1978 Japanese animated science fiction action comedy film; it is the first animated film of the Lupin III franchise created by manga author Monkey Punch. The film was originally released in Japan as Lupin III (ルパン三世, Rupan Sansei) but was later retitled to Lupin III: Lupin vs. the Clone (ルパン三世 ルパンVS複製人間クローン, Rupan Sansei: Rupan tai Kurōn) to differentiate it from other elements of the franchise. Directed by Sōji Yoshikawa from a screenplay by Yoshikawa and cult pink film screenwriter Atsushi Yamatoya, the film was produced by animation studio Tokyo Movie Shinsha and distributed by Toho. 

The film's plot follows master thief Arsène Lupin III, who attempts to foil Mamo ― a wealthy and powerful recluse seeking immortality ― while trying to win the affections of his rival and would-be lover, Fujiko Mine.

info.title: Photon: The Idiot Adventures
info.synopsis: Photon Earth è un ragazzo giovane e gentile dotato di una forza sovrumana e della scritta "Baka" (che significa "idiota" in giapponese) scarabocchiato sulla fronte (apparentemente dall'amica combinaguai Aun Freya). Un giorno, si ritrova fidanzato con la bella pilota latitante Keyne Acqua dopo aver scritto "baka" sulla fronte. E questa è l'ultima delle sue preoccupazioni, perché deve proteggere sia Aun che Keyne dal malvagio Papacharino, che vuole rubare i segreti di "Aho" (un'altra parola per dire "idiota"), l'energia dalla nave del nonno di Keyne.

episodes.title: Aun Is an Idiot
episodes.synopsis: Keyne Acqua is a renegade being chased by the evil Papachurino, crash landing onto Earth. In the same planet, Photon is asked to bring back Aun, who's out chasing after her dream boy "Laman" yet again. Though during his pursuit, Photon found himself in a mysterious spaceship with a woman lying naked in the middle of it.

episodes.title: The New Bride Keyne
episodes.synopsis: Aun found out the hard way that she isn't the only girl alive in Laman's world. She makes an unusual encounter with Papachurino, and work together to find Photon and Keyne.

episodes.title: Lashara Leaves Home
episodes.synopsis: Photon wakes up with an angry stomach. Keyne and Aun compete with each other to bake Photon their best meals in order to outclass one another, but sir Papacha always manages to spoil the food. Though does he know yet that Princess Lashara is coming to Sandy Planet too?

episodes.title: Pochi`s Feelings
episodes.synopsis: Papacha decided to party it out in an Inn, but refused to pay and is now working his way to cover the fees. Aun, Photon, Pochi #1, and Keyne, decide to pay a visit to that very same Inn. Lashara also stops by.

episodes.title: Papacha Turns the Key
episodes.synopsis: Keyne seems to have finally found the answer to her long journey on earth after discovering the devil's hot spring. Though little did she know that Sir Papacha had already arrived in the same destination.

episodes.title: Photon on the Green Planet
episodes.synopsis: Faces are revealed, families ties are being exploited, and it seems The Galactic Emporer has won, though it's Photon who foils his plans. However, Sir Papacha comes out of nowhere with Gene's Genie, ready to visit the Anti Aho furnace.

info.title: A Star Brighter Than the Sun (ITA)
info.synopsis: Sae Iwata è una ragazza più grande della media che prova timidezza per la sua altezza mentre il suo amico d'infanzia Koki, che da piccolo era gracile, crescendo è diventato un bel ragazzo. La ragazza pensava si fossero allontanati, ma durante l'ultimo festival sportivo delle medie si sono riuniti. Ora, arrivati alle superiori, Sae si rende conto di provare dei sentimenti per lui ma anche di non essere l'unica ad essere interessata all'amico. La vera domanda è una sola... per chi prova sentimenti Koki?

episodes.title: The Day I Reached out My Hand
episodes.synopsis: Sae Iwata is a slightly tougher-than-average girl. Her first love, Koki Kamishiro, was once a delicate and fragile boy, but now, in their third year of junior high, he has grown into a cool and popular young man. Although they have drifted apart, her feelings remain unchanged. When they are paired up to help prepare for the sports festival, Sae’s long-hidden first love begins to stir once more.

episodes.title: Call My Name
episodes.synopsis: Sae and Kamishiro end up in the same high school and class. Assigned to the same group for trash pickup, Kamishiro gets into a sudden argument with a classmate. As Sae steps in, he instinctively calls her by her first name, bringing back a flood of childhood memories. Meanwhile, another girl, Hisui, seems to be drawn to Kamishiro as well.

episodes.title: No Matter How Far
episodes.synopsis: Knowing Kamishiro has a crush on someone weighs heavily on Sae’s heart. Still, during their school trip, Sae finds herself unable to take her eyes off him. Her friends, Hisui and Kagawa, try their best to support her, but Sae always ends up showing her awkward side around Kamishiro.

episodes.title: He`s Still There Even When I Close My Eyes
episodes.synopsis: Kamishiro admits to Sae that he has feelings for someone, describing his crush as "a star that shines brighter than the sun." The words pierce her heart, but she chooses to support him nonetheless. All the same, as Kamishiro continues to treat Sae just like always, she finds herself torn between her feelings and her resolve.

episodes.title: Jumping and Swinging
episodes.synopsis: After the school trip, a class-versus-class jump rope tournament is set to take place, and Sae and Kamishiro are chosen to swing the rope. Despite the unexpected pairing, Sae tries not to be too conscious of Kamishiro. As practice begins, things do not go as smoothly as expected. One day after school, Sae spots Kagawa practicing alone behind the school building.

episodes.title: Brains, Heart, and Courage
episodes.synopsis: One day, Sae takes a day off from school. The next day, Kamishiro gets injured during club practice and also takes a day off. As they lend each other their notebooks to catch up on missed classes, they begin exchanging messages. A small incident leads Kamishiro to realize that Sae likes someone. Unaware of Sae's true feelings, he encourages her to go for it.

episodes.title: Sun-Shower
episodes.synopsis: Kamishiro is selected as one of the main cast members for the class play. Struggling with his lines, he turns to Sae for help. As they rehearse, they make a promise to go see a movie together during summer break. On the big day, the class's performance is going smoothly until Sae suddenly bursts onto the stage.

episodes.title: Ten Years
episodes.synopsis: With school events behind her, Sae throws herself into club activities. Just then, the date for her long-awaited movie outing with Kamishiro is set. However, a chance encounter with Kamishiro's cousin, Subaru, leaves Sae feeling uneasy, as something Kamishiro once said about his crush comes back to her.

episodes.title: Someone`s Feelings
episodes.synopsis: After their movie date, Sae once again realizes that unless she expresses her feelings, Kamishiro will never notice them. Learning from Hisui that the school festival is a time for love confessions, she decides to tell him during the after-party. While preparing for the event, Sae finds Subaru's painting vandalized, and the situation makes her look like the culprit.

episodes.title: Rumors
episodes.synopsis: As preparations for the class exhibit progress, Sae tries to talk to Kamishiro, but the timing never seems right. On top of that, Hisui points out that she has been spending most of her time with Ayukawa. Just when Sae decides to be more proactive, Kamishiro makes an unexpected proposal.

episodes.title: A Star Without a Constellation
episodes.synopsis: Worried about Subaru, Sae visits the nurse's office. There, Kamishiro notices Subaru trying to act fine and offers to help during the school festival. Sae feels a twinge of loneliness, as she had planned to confess her feelings to him then. However, Kamishiro makes it clear that he will not be available during his reception desk shift with Sae.

episodes.title: A Star Brighter Than the Sun
episodes.synopsis: After hearing that Kamishiro plans to confess to the person he likes, Sae impulsively blurts out her feelings to him. Overcome with emotion, she runs away, convinced she has been rejected. She hides in the gym storage room, crying until the door slowly opens and Kamishiro appears.

info.title: Legend of Black Heaven
info.synopsis: Tutti nella nostra vita abbiamo avuto almeno un sogno, al quale, come spesso accade, siamo stati costretti a rinunciare. Il sogno di Oji Tanaka era diventare una grande rock star. 15 anni fa era conosciuto come Gabe, il leader di un gruppo heavy metal chiamato Black Heaven e tutto sembrava andare alla grande... Ma si sa, spesso la vita non va come ci si aspetta. Costretto ad abbandonare il proprio sogno, oggi Oji Tanaka è un uomo di mezza età con una moglie, un figlio in tenera età e un noioso lavoro da impiegato. La sua vita gli sembra scorrere lenta e monotona se paragonata allo splendore di quei giorni. Ma il destino ha in serbo altro per lui. Riuscirà questo eroico padre di famiglia, accompagnato dalla sua fedele Flying V, a salvare l'universo con la sua musica?

episodes.title: Stairway to Heaven
episodes.synopsis: Somewhere in the depths of space two mighty space fleets clash. Meanwhile, back on Earth Oji Tanaka, once the lead guitarist for the hot heavy metal band Black Heaven has hit the wall. Oji cashed out of the rock biz and is now trapped in a life he considers a lie - that of a dull salaryman with a young family. But even as Oji tries to cling to his past, his ruthlessly practical wife Yoshiko, once the founder of his fan club, is throwing out his prized rock mementos to make room for their growing family. On the day he hits rock bottom, she trashes his last and most cherished Flying V guitar. His life changes forever when he meets the lovely Layla Yuki, a new employee in his office. Professing to be an old fan, she ushers a drunken Oji to a private stage secreted in the back of an empty model home and up a glowing stairway where she reunites him with his lost Flying V. Oji is overjoyed, and plays for her. But Layla isn't what she seems.

episodes.title: All Night Long
episodes.synopsis:
Oji wakes up the next morning wondering if his time with Layla was a dream, but she soon appears to assure him it wasn't, asking for his help to save her people. Oji assumes she's joking about inter-stellar battles, but he can't wait to play his guitar again, so he plays along with her story. They step through an office door and onto a large stage, where he plays the night away.
Oji's recent all-night disappearances have got Yoshiko steamed, but to make it up to her, Oji offers to take her to tour the new model homes in a nearby development. While there, though, Layla appears to tell him his playing is desperately needed, and leaves her three ditzy lackeys Kotoko, Eriko and Rinko to keep Yoshiko distracted. Oji really cranks his guitar this time. But while he beams, thinking he's playing in a trendy nightclub, his music is actually powering a super-powerful weapon that destroys an enemy fleet.

episodes.title: Hot House
episodes.synopsis: Layla's commander and ex-lover Fomalhaut is determined to reproduce Oji's killer sound without depending on the artist himself. He dispatches her to more closely observe Oji, and, as a backup, also sends Kotoko, Eriko and Rinko to make more remote observations. Meanwhile, the other housewives living in the Tanakas' apartment building buzz with rumors that Oji has taken a lover, and while Yoshiko doesn't believe it, she is none-too-pleased when beautiful Layla shows up on their doorstep, on the young couple's anniversary no less, and proceeds to spend the entire day mooning over Oji's career. Matters don't improve when Kotoko, Eriko and Rinko decide to create a love nest for Layla and Oji when Yoshiko steps out to shop.

episodes.title: Space Child
episodes.synopsis:
Oji agrees to watch Gen, the couple's son, while Yoshiko heads to a high school reunion. While strolling with the little tike in the park, Oji realizes that he knows virtually nothing about his son aside from the boy's total obsession over the TV show ""UFO Ranger Flying 5"" (which curiously stars a woman who looks just like Layla and seems to feature adventures which parallel Oji's own).
While watching Gen play, Oji gets a cell call from Layla who, with her fleet under attack, insists that he perform immediately. Oji drops everything, leaving his son in the park. As Oji revs up his sound, Gen sneaks aboard the mothership and immediately becomes a target for the ship's deadly defense systems.

episodes.title: These are the Days
episodes.synopsis: Oji Tanaka, formerly the lead guitarist of the '80s metal band Black Heaven, is walking on air. He's playing his guitar again, he's pulled out his old hip duds, and his Muse has returned - he's composing a new ballad. He bugs Layla about a chance to try his new song, and, based on his confidence, the aliens enter a key battle counting on increased power from his sound. Unfortunately, Oji's new mellow sound is utterly ineffective in powering the weapon, and it is only when Fomalhaut arrives to pull the plug that Oji finally twigs to the fact that he's participating in a galactic war - and that Earth will fall into jeopardy if they fail. Even worse, he learns that no one cares about his music beyond its ability to wreak destruction. His delusions and dreams shattered, Oji smashes his guitar and walks.

episodes.title: Walk Away
episodes.synopsis: His spirit crushed, Oji throws himself into his work, determined to put the ""childishness"" of his music career behind him - he even turns down a ticket to a rock concert held by his idol Michael Schenker. Meanwhile, the three alien ditzes Kotoko, Eriko and Rinko are dispatched to re-ignite Oji's passion for music - but, predictably, their hair-brained schemes fall apart. In the end, Layla simply hands him his restored Flying V. He accepts it without knowing why.

episodes.title: In Need
episodes.synopsis: Fomalhaut's forces are taking a shellacking, forcing Layla to pilot one of their starfighters. To her shock, though, the ultimate weapon goes online and smashes the opposition. She rushes back to find Oji playing under the guidance of the beautiful but cold fleet scientist Hamil. It seems Oji has had a change of heart about playing. But, alas, something has gone out of his music, and the weapon is not as powerful as it once was. Suspecting the source of the problem, Hamil pounces on a startled Oji in a Tokyo alley, feigning a nearly sexual passion for his music. This reinvigorates Oji, but also brings Layla charging in. She sees that Hamil is manipulating Oji, and wanting to come by his talents more honestly, takes him back under her wing - which is actually what Hamil wanted all along. Meanwhile, Oji gets a brainstorm: If he alone can generate such power, what could a reunited Black Heaven accomplish?

episodes.title: All Right Now
episodes.synopsis: Oji reunites with 3 of the 4 other members of Black Heaven in hopes of convincing them to reunite and start playing once again. Unfortunately no one showed up at the agreed time. Oji goes to try once again to convince the other members about restarting Black Heaven when he finally realizes that they all actually have families now with different priorities.

episodes.title: Get Off of my Cloud
episodes.synopsis:
Figuring he could start another band, Oji makes up flyers for auditions and has 3 hits for it. Oji decides to accept them for their ""Outer space attitude"", except the 3 new members all have their quirks and start fighting amongst each other.  Oji gets them to reconcile, and they plan to meet at the model homes the next day.
Oji is called to action, but the three members catch the wrong bus and end up in Aomori, 700km away.  Oji ends up playing solo but breaks a guitar string.  Just as he's about to give up, a drum beat is heard and lights are hit showing that 'Michael' Sato, 'Raphael' Suzuki and 'Luke' Yamada are all there to back Oji up.  The band is back together!  They easily blow away the enemy.  Afterwards at the food cart Oji asks what made them decide to show up after all. And 'Raphael' keeps toasting (again&again&again...) to the belated reunion of Black Heaven.

episodes.title: Ten Years Ago
episodes.synopsis: The group is once again shown playing on Layla's ship, when they suddenly stop claiming a 'keyboard solo'; Fomalhaut screams to keep playing. They start up again saying keyboard solo over. The reason for not being able to have a full reunion is revealed due to the fact that Watanabe (the keyboardist) is dead (the true story behind his death courtesy of Yoshiko). The group tries to figure out who can fill his place when Layla suggests her self.

episodes.title: Sweet Emotion
episodes.synopsis: Layla shows up at the warehouse dressed in a 'Chinese waitress' style outfit. She's having problems the rapid changes in notes when trying to play Watanabe's role. Yoko confronts her about being a sort of home-wrecker. In order to boost Layla's confidence, Eriko, Kotoko, and Rinko put her through the most ridiculous training regiment. When about to try again with the rest of the guys, they are all called to action. Layla surprises the guys by nailing the keyboard bit. However, their power is canceled out by the enemy's secret weapon: a clone of Watanabe playing the same keyboard sequence as Layla.

episodes.title: Into the Arena
episodes.synopsis: After discovering that the enemy has created a 'Watanabe' clone, the group decides to start practicing some new stuff. The guys all tell their families that they have to go away for awhile and Yoko is the only one semi-against it. She believes that Oji is making up the whole story. The end of the episode has the group charging up onto a stage on a new ship created by Hamill named (by the guys) the 'Zappa'.

episodes.title: The End
episodes.synopsis: The enemy's Mecha-nabe is too much for the group to handle. It's capable of neutralizing their music. With one last option in mind, Oji calls home trying to get in contact with Yoshiko, who appears to be leaving him with divorce papers on the table. To his surprise, she shows up along with other people who were touched by Black Heaven's music. Oji starts to play the soft melody song from earlier episode. The rest of the group joins in and together they destroy Mecha-nabe. As the credits roll, Layla and Oji talk about how they're going their separate ways and how Oji will probably think it was all a dream. She gives him a little reminder to which he'll always know that it was real.

info.title: Special Powered Armor Troop Dorvack
info.synopsis: Nell'anno 1999 ha inizio un invasione da parte degli Ideliani che intendono conquistare la Terra. Le forze difensive terrestri non possono competere con le potenze nemiche, tuttavia c'è un'unità conosciuta con il nome di Tokusou Kihei Dorvack, che dimostra di essere in grado di infliggere ingenti danni all'invasore. Makoto Mugen, Pierre Bonaparte, Louise Oberon e il colonnello Takashiro combatteranno il nemico grazie all'utilizzo di particolari robot.

info.title: Kill Blue (ITA)
info.synopsis: Jūzō Ōgami è un leggendario sicario che non ha mai fallito una missione, per quanto impossibile potesse sembrare. Un giorno, dopo aver eliminato una potente organizzazione, viene punto da una misteriosa vespa e perde conoscenza. Al suo risveglio, il temibile assassino trentanovenne si ritrova trasformato in un ragazzino di 13 anni! Prima ancora di riuscire a capire cosa sia successo, il suo capo gli affida un nuovo incarico: "Infiltrati in una scuola media con quel corpo." Quello che lo attende è una vita scolastica del tutto inaspettata, piena di compagni eccentrici, caos adolescenziale e pericoli in agguato. Riuscirà Jūzō a tornare alla sua forma originale? O gli assassini che gli stanno dando la caccia metteranno fine alla sua seconda vita prima ancora che inizi davvero!?

episodes.title: Let`s Go to School
episodes.synopsis: A middle-aged hit man is embedded into a local middle school after a wasp sting reverse ages his body.

episodes.title: Noren Mitsuoka
episodes.synopsis: A hit man saves his mark after she's been kidnapped.

episodes.title: Wipe Your Own Butt
episodes.synopsis: Ogami is forced to realize that his gender norm bias is outdated.

episodes.title: The Pacifier Duel
episodes.synopsis: Ogami battles an undercover operative who is trying to win the hand of Noren.

episodes.title: There`s a Unicorn up Ahead
episodes.synopsis: Noren begins to wonder who Ogami really is.

episodes.title: How About a "Thank You"?
episodes.synopsis: Ogami almost blows his cover by showing off his athleticism.

episodes.title: Doki-Doki Double Date
episodes.synopsis: Noren is kidnapped while on a double date with Ogami.

episodes.title: Versus the Rindou Brothers
episodes.synopsis: Ogami and Tenma battle the Rindou brothers in order to save Noren.

episodes.title: The Impossible Aftermath of an Impossible Game
episodes.synopsis: Juzo races to Noren's side. Meanwhile, Tenma and Eiji clash in an outrageous soccer-vs.-explosive-golf battle. Tenma prepares to end the fight with a move he developed in practice. But at the end of the life-or-death struggle against Kazuma and Eiji, the unconscious Noren awakens, and the first thing she sees is...

episodes.title: Death or Kiss
episodes.synopsis: After Kazuma’s hypnosis makes Noren fall deeply for Juzo, she launches an all-out attack on his heart. But when Juzo gently turns her down, she tries to jump from the roof! Desperate to undo the spell, Juzo takes Noren to meet Kazuma at an amusement park, only to end up alone with her on a Ferris wheel, where things take a dangerously romantic turn?!

episodes.title: The First Hitman Summit
episodes.synopsis: Juzo has been enjoying a peaceful school life, but that ends when Kazuma and Eiji transfer in, bringing the total number of assassins infiltrating his middle school to four. Meanwhile, the Home Ec Club holds a serious ramen-making contest. Paired with Noren, Juzo heads out to research ramen shops and saves a girl from being hit by a truck. But just who is she?

episodes.title: Life Paths
episodes.synopsis: Unicorn Mai Otohime is a marine-sports prodigy with expert-level ocean knowledge. She has come for a Mitsuoka Duel too, but her target is Juzo. This leads to Noren challenging Mai herself. As the duel nears, Juzo and the others face parent-teacher conferences and questions about their futures, leading Juzo to reflect on his school life, the friends he’s made, and the possibilities ahead.

info.title: Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha EXCEEDS Gun Blaze Vengeance
info.synopsis: Trent’anni fa, l’improvvisa comparsa di misteriose forme di vita aliene rischiò di distruggere il mondo. Da allora, l’umanità e queste “Specie Invasive” continuano a scontrarsi per il territorio, rendendo il pianeta un luogo pericoloso e precario. Per affrontare la minaccia, le Nazioni Unite creano EXCEEDS, un’organizzazione incaricata di studiare e combattere queste creature. Nell’isola orientale di Mizuho, Shiina Kuze, giovane cacciatrice di specie invasive, vive con la sorella minore Setsuna; tutto sembra tranquillo, finché un incidente imprevisto la trascina in un conflitto ben più grande di lei...

info.title: Puella Magi Yotsugi☆Peace
info.synopsis: La protagonista è Yotsugi Ononoki, personaggio della Monogatari Series, che viene reinterpretata come una magical girl. La storia comincia quando Tsukihi Araragi scopre Yotsugi mentre mangia il gelato dopo essere tornata prima da scuola. Yotsugi le rivela di essere una magical girl. Tsukihi decide quindi di diventare a sua volta una magical girl e Yotsugi chiede aiuto a Nadeko Sengoku per preparare il costume e il relativo oggetto magico.

info.title: Karna the Guardian
info.synopsis: Karna è un ragazzo che vive una vita normale, finché l'antico demone Kalimba si libera e porta la sua corruzione nel mondo. Quando l'oscurità infetta sua madre, si risvegliano i poteri di Karna, si scopre così la sua vera identità: il Compensatore, un Guardiano nato per ripristinare l'armonia nel mondo. Per salvare sua madre e fermare il caos portato da Kalimba, Karna dovrà allenarsi per padroneggiare il suo potere interiore o rischia di perdere tutto.
